review: finite static review of pure M1 token collector

retained_tests.qualification: synthetic pure Core translation and accounting; report read, no tests rerun

confirmed_by_reading: Six reservations are global across reserve/prearm and setup/work stages.
Prearm persists the exclusive logical reservation before a session/stream exists; retries do not authorize another dispatch.
Operation binding and settlement include stream namespace. Conflicting usage-operation identity latches a fault.
Unknown/malformed pages, replay conflicts, counter regression, missing turn start/terminal/usage and replay backlog block new reservation.
High-water accounting accepts observed usage without claiming final billing or a nonexistent final native marker; asynchronous preventive threshold100000 and tolerance700000 remain distinct.
No I/O/native/credential/dispatch behavior exists inside collector; persistence/CAS/recovery remain controller responsibilities.

findings.problem: reserve accepts an enrolled stream after it was retired by explicit same-thread handover.
findings.reproduction_by_reading: Settle one request on stream A; enroll the same native thread at epochB and observe its empty caught-up page (existing handover helper path). reserve(new_request, stream=A) passes global summary and returns dispatch_permitted=True. Any subsequent new event on A is rejected as RETIRED_STREAM_ADVANCED; events on B cannot settle a request scoped to A.
findings.minimal_fix: Refuse a new reservation on retired streams, without dispatch. Preserve duplicate request semantics and other stream admission gates.
